### Why, God? Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-december-14-15-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 60:12
Points:
- Tragic events and widespread evil expose human fallenness while underscoring the preciousness of life and liberty.
- Destructive forces seek to paralyze people with fear and intimidate them through repeated hostility.
- Believers can stand firm against threats knowing that God's ultimate victory is secure.
- Christians are called to face adversaries with resolve while bowing humbly before God in renewed faith.
- Lasting courage and triumphant perseverance come through quiet confidence and total dependence on the Lord.
